description: Hand-reasoned transition-scenario cases, m1-draft-4 (D-017..D-019), from SCENARIOS.md. PENDING INDEPENDENT REVIEW. A step {"promote": spec} expands to a promote operation: request = base_request merged with spec.request_patch; record = acceptance base_record with spec.record (record_patch, criteria_patch, criteria_replace), digest recomputed, or null when spec.record is null; permit = {request_fingerprint, record_digest (null when no record), authorization_bundle_sha (state's active one unless spec.permit_authorization_bundle_sha)} computed for the request and record named by spec.permit_for (default: the actual ones), or null when spec.permit is null; spec.fault is copied. A step {"effect": spec} expands to an effect operation on base_effect_request merged with spec.request_patch, with a permit computed the same way. initial_patch merges into base_initial. text_edit cases are sent as input_text. Changes: m1/fixtures/AMENDMENT-1.md, AMENDMENT-2.md and AMENDMENT-3.md. compare one_of: the expect object holds one_of, a list of acceptable outputs (serialization orders of a concurrent step).
